terminal_policy: Retain all failures and receipts; close all unused epoch slots after this one terminal process. No benchmark continuation or extra probe within this epoch.
cleanup_plan: Outer launcher starts one new process group, applies watchdog/deadline, terminates all owned workers and descendants, records actual exit/resource/cleanup and verifies no live owned process. Keep OS work lock until reviewed checkpoint publication readback; then release and prove lock free.
future_paid_work: Requires actually authorized remaining cap plus a newly frozen price/time/cleanup plan; no budget is inferred from historical spend authority.
